g.text: Expectation adds simply; variance needs the covariance

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: E(aX + bY) = aE(X) + bE(Y) always. Var(aX + bY) adds 2ab·Cov(X, Y), which is 0 only without a linear link.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: For n independent observations, Var(x̄) = σ²/n, so SE = σ/√n. Correlated data (pairs, clusters) need the Cov terms.
